apps/web/components/features/dashboard/d.empty: The row draws one NavItem and owns no collection; the detector matched the word links in the comment "Optional click side effect for links or buttons".
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/d.error: The row draws no failure face: a failed Copy link shows toast.error("Failed to copy link") in the app-wide toaster, outside this component.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/d.offline: The row never fetches; pending is a paint-only acknowledgment while the route resolves (LoadingPendingDestination), and an offline navigation fails in the router, outside this row.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/m.error: A pure display of five numeric scores with no fetch, handler or failure input; the detector matched the colour classes "text-error" and "bg-error/60" used for a low score (LowConfidence).
The card draws no failure face: an unreadable localStorage falls back to setDismissed(false) and shows the card, with captureWarning for tracking; ProfileCompletionCard.test.tsx covers it.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/m.permission-denied: The card has no gated action or permission input; the detector matched role='progressbar'. The not-live variant, which hides the dismiss button, is PartialNotLiveYet.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/m.error: Its failures are transient status lines set by a user action ("Could not copy payment link.", "Could not download PNG QR code.") in the aria-live paragraph, and a failed QR preview falls back to the placeholder; no prop reaches them, so ProfilePaySurface.test.tsx covers each by interaction.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.error: The section draws no failure face: a failed export or delete is reported by the mutation hooks' toast ("useDeleteAccountMutation surfaces the failure toast."), outside this component, and the buttons return to idle. DataPrivacySection.test.tsx covers a failed delete that does not sign out.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: An offline export or delete fails the fetch and lands in the same mutation-hook toast as any other failure, outside this component; the section keeps its idle rows.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.empty: An icon-only trigger whose only prop is onOpen; it holds no collection. The detector matched the items-center class on the button.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.long-content: Every visible part is fixed: a PanelRight icon and aria-label="Open Profile Panel"; no caller text reaches it. The detector matched that aria-label and the text-secondary-token class.
